<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)> <!ENTITY ent 'expanded_entity'>">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Comment containing markup-like chars <child>&ent;</child> -->
  <ns2:child>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with embedded tags <root> &ext; </root>
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext_pe SYSTEM "http://example.com/dtd.dtd">
  %ext_pe;
  <!ENTITY base "BaseText">
  <!ENTITY complex "&base; &base; &base;">
>
<?target data="processing instruction value"?>
<database xmlns="http://xml.org/db" xmlns:foo="http://xml.org/foo">
  <!-- Deeply nested comment structure with hyphens - -- - -->
  <foo:record foo:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with entity reference &complex;
    ]]>
  </foo:record>
  <record>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&complex;</record>
</database>
```

  <!ELEMENT testDoc (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Value2 &e1;">
  <!ENTITY e3 "Value3 &e2;">
  <!ENTITY % internal "
    <!ELEMENT nested (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY deep 'DeepEntity'>
  ">
  %internal;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<testDoc xmlns="http://test.org/doc" xmlns:p="http://test.org/p" xmlns:q="http://test.org/q">
  <!-- Comment before CDATA -->
  <p:item>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing entity reference &e3; inside p:item
    ]]>
  </p:item>
  <q:item>
    <?p:target attr="val"?>
    &deep;
  </q:item>
</testDoc>

<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (case*)>
  <!ELEMENT case (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "EntityA">
  <!ENTITY entB "EntityB &entA;">
  <!ENTITY entC "EntityC &entB;">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ENTITY entD 'EntityD &entC;'>">
  %dtdMacro;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<suite xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/ws/policy" xmlns:ws="http://www.w3.org/ns/ws-policy">
  <!-- Top-level comment block -->
  <!-- Another comment with special chars: <, >, &, ", ' -->
  <ws:case>
    <![CDATA[
      <suite><case>&entD;</case></suite>
    ]]>
  </ws:case>
  <case>&entD;</case>
</suite>
